capacity.overflow: Stop fixed attempt, no replacement or silent retry

cost: All U/V/R/M calls counted for every logical service even when measurement cache reuses; GPU residency charged once including loading/failures; feedback/init not yet evaluated

gate_conjunction.complete_logical_cost_vs_independent3_Q: token ratio <=0.85 AND GPU kernel ratio <=0.90
gate_conjunction.credit_Q_FULL: D >=0.05, both seeds >0, >=20 nonzero question-mean D
gate_conjunction.single_Q: mean >= +0.02, both seeds > 0, >=20 nonzero question-mean contrasts

gates_are: Prospective empirical development filters; not significance, population noninferiority, or proof of method benefit
hypotheses: Holding all upstream messages fixed, final raw-context access changes quality and credit shift.
Holding upstream messages and access fixed, receiver Q versus M changes quality.
A fixed nominated graph can retain useful differential credit while matching a costlier independent aggregation and beating cheap controls.

population.selection: First 96 unexposed groups in original fixed pool order passing all seven static capacities; no pool expansion

primary_measure: Official normalized exact match, paired question and seed decomposition
purpose: Foundation/operator diagnosis for graph-conditional credit, not an innovative predictor or validated online policy
release: No gold before fixed complete archive, actual cost closure, exact CPU replay and hash-bound root label release; all selected data becomes development after scoring
secondary: Other cells, factorial interactions, corrections/breakages, F1, per-seed quality and all full costs; no substitute winner
stopping: Candidate failure ends nominee; outer loop continues within project limits. No old metric or old exposure changes.

treatments.upstream: Identical Q/Q/M source and relay requests shared across four cells
treatments.vote: Three Q full-context short-answer samples, normalized plurality, M/U/V tie order, raw selected text
